maria.docs: Quick heads-up — I'm going through the SDK examples to align streaming, retries, and pagination semantics across Python/TS/Go. Found a couple of inconsistencies in the pagination token handling in Go and the retry backoff code in TS. I'll open a WIP PR in ~30–60m and drop links here.

samir.devex: Thanks! Can you list the specific files you plan to touch so I can flag any snippets we ship in the quickstarts?

maria.docs: Sure — main ones: docs/sdk/python/quickstart.md (streaming example), docs/sdk/ts/usage.md (retry example), docs/sdk/go/pagination.md (token handling). Also a small fix in docs/api/streaming.md where we forgot to show `await response.text()` on the client example.

alex.engineer: For Go pagination, are we moving to the new `PageToken` semantics (token + next_page_token) or keeping the legacy `since` cursor? The client SDK uses a `NextToken()` accessor right now.

maria.docs: Good question. The platform now returns `next_page_token` consistently. Update the Go snippet to show `resp.NextPageToken` and an example loop: ```go
for {
    req.PageToken = resp.NextPageToken
    resp, err = client.ListItems(ctx, req)
    if err != nil {
        // retry/backoff handled by SDK wrapper in examples below
        break
    }
    // process resp.Items
    if resp.NextPageToken == "" {
        break
    }
}
```

jen.sdk: For TypeScript retries, we changed the SDK to expose `retry.withExponentialBackoff()` util. Docs should show the small wrapper and recommend idempotency for POSTs. Maybe include code like: ```ts
const withRetry = retry.withExponentialBackoff({
  maxRetries: 4,
  baseMs: 200,
});
await withRetry(() => client.generate({ prompt }));
```

samir.devex: Also call out streaming chunk boundaries — previously our Python example concatenated chunks without checking `is_final` flag and that caused subtle bugs for structured outputs.

maria.docs: Yep, changing Python streaming snippet to use the `is_final` / `delta` pattern. Example: ```py
with client.stream_generate(...) as stream:
    for event in stream:
        if event.type == 'delta':
            buf += event.delta
        elif event.type == 'is_final':
            print('final:', buf)
            buf = ''
```

tyler.sre: FYI the runtime changed the header for retry-after to `x-retry-after-ms` in error responses last week — docs should reflect that in the examples where we inspect headers to compute backoff.

maria.docs: Thanks, I'll update the note and add a one-line snippet in TS/Python showing header read: ```py
wait_ms = int(resp.headers.get('x-retry-after-ms', 0))
```

alex.engineer: One small ask — can we keep the Go example showing context cancellation for streaming/pagination loops? People love the `ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(...)` pattern.

maria.docs: Good call. Will include: ```go
ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 30*time.Second)
defer cancel()
// use ctx in client calls so loops can be cancelled by callers
```

jen.sdk: When you open the PR, please add a short migration note at the top: "Upgrading snippets for retry header and pagination token semantics (May 2025)". Also mark any breaking examples clearly.

maria.docs: Will do. Plan: 1) open WIP PR with changes and run docs build to catch any rendering issues; 2) ask for a quick SDK-engineer review from @jen.sdk and @alex.engineer; 3) once approved, merge and backfill changelog.

samir.devex: Need to check if these examples are mirrored in the quickstart repo too. If so, we should either update both or hyperlink to a single canonical snippet to avoid drift.

maria.docs: Agreed. I'll replace the duplicate quickstart snippets with a codeinclude remote link to docs/_includes/snippets/<lang>/streaming-1.* so one source of truth.

tyler.sre: Docs-bot FYI: please add an automated smoke check for the streaming snippets so the integration test can run them against a local stub.

docs-bot: Noted. I've created ISSUE-312 in the docs board to add snippet smoke tests.

alex.engineer: One more: update the TS example to use `response.stream()` and show `for await (const chunk of response)` instead of old `on('data', ...)` event handler. That will align with modern Node APIs.

maria.docs: Got it. I'll also add a tiny note about Node version requirement (>=16.8 for `for await`).

samir.devex: Awesome. Ping me when the PR is ready and I'll help shepherd the reviews so it doesn't linger.

maria.docs: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/842 (WIP) — contains Python/TS/Go updates + migration note. A few tests failing in CI because of lint rules around code fence languages, will fix.

jen.sdk: Reviewing now. Quick scan: looks good, left two tiny comments about wording around idempotency.

maria.docs: Addressed comments, pushed fixes. Marking as ready for review.

samir.devex: Approved. Merging after CI passes. Please remember to update the snippets index page so the SDK quickstarts pick up the canonical include.

maria.docs: Will update index and add a small entry to release notes. Thanks all! :raised_hands:
